title: Servicemembers Civil Relief Act Rate Cap on Retail Installment Contracts
content:
**Who qualifies.** On Retail Installment Contracts, the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act rate cap (50 U.S.C. 3937) applies only to a contract whose contract date is earlier than the borrower's active-duty start date on file.

**Request.** The cap is applied only on a written request of request type SCRA rate cap, accompanied by a copy of the military orders, that the borrower has signed. The request must be received no later than the product's request window in days after the end of military service. The window is counted in calendar days from the active-duty end date on file, a request received on the last day is in time, and a request made while service is continuing (no end date on file) is always in time.

**Effect.** When the cap applies, the rate is reduced to the lower of the current APR and the product's rate cap, effective from the active-duty start date. Interest above the cap is forgiven, never deferred, and interest already charged above the cap since that date is credited to principal as an SCRA interest credit linked to the rate-cap record.

**Payment.** The scheduled payment is reduced by one month of forgiven interest: the principal balance on the effective date multiplied by the difference between the current APR and the cap, divided by 100 and by 12, rounded half-up to the cent.

**End of the cap.** The cap ends the day after the active-duty end date, when the APR returns to the original APR and the scheduled payment returns to its pre-cap amount (rate cap ended). No fee is charged for either action. A contract that already carries an APR at or below the cap is not changed.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contract, cap of 6.0%)

Principal 12000.00 at 22.00%, scheduled payment 450.00. Payment reduction: 12000.00 multiplied by 16.00 (22.00 less 6.0), divided by 100 and by 12, that is 160.00. New scheduled payment: 290.00; new rate 6.0%.

## Request window (hypothetical dates, 180-day window, non-leap year)

| Active-duty end date | Last day a request is in time | Late |
|---|---|---|
| 31 January | 30 July | received 31 July |
| none on file (still serving) | always in time | — |

A contract signed after the active-duty start date does not qualify, however the request is timed.
